title: Saving 500 Condors Didn't End Their Biggest Threat
hook: Only 27 condors survived, and poison still threatens the comeback.
closing: Recovery works only when the food keeping condors alive stops poisoning them.
question: Would you protect condor habitat?

segments.say: About 500 condors live today. A species once near extinction now has a real population again.
The population passed 300 in 2008. Recovery took decades, showing how slowly a rescued species returns.
Lead causes 50% of wild condor deaths. Their biggest remaining threat is hidden inside the food they scavenge.
